ConnectionStrings._comment: Dedicated Postgres database on the same server the main FHIRBridge product uses - never that product's own 'FHIRBridge' database. Override via ConnectionStrings__LicenseServerDb for a real deployment (a client's Azure Postgres, etc.) - the app creates the database and applies migrations automatically on startup against whatever is configured here.

AdminCredentials._comment_Password: Leave Password unset to get a random one-time password logged at startup. Set it here (not recommended for anything but quick local testing) or via the AdminCredentials__Password environment variable for a real deployment.

LicenseSigning._comment: Leave PfxPath blank for local dev/testing — the app falls back to its own embedded throwaway dev keypair (see Licensing/LicenseSigningKeyProvider.cs). For a real deployment, point PfxPath at the real PegasusOne FHIRBridge Licensing PFX (10-year self-signed cert, CN=PegasusOne FHIRBridge Licensing) and set PfxPassword via the LicenseSigning__PfxPassword environment variable instead of writing it here.
LicenseSigning._comment_ExpectedPublicKeyBase64: Informational only (see LicenseSigningOptions.ExpectedPublicKeyBase64). This IS the real production public key the user already gave us for CN=PegasusOne FHIRBridge Licensing — used only to warn at startup if PfxPath ever loads a DIFFERENT keypair than this one.
